messages:
Sarah (sales): Heads-up — SummitHealth emailed asking for SOC 2/ISO artifacts + signed pen-test attestation. They want the POC to start Mon 4/15 and need evidence uploaded by Thu. Can we confirm staging window + any billing uplift for a short single-tenant burst?
Alejandro (SE): Got it. For POC we usually provide a 72h staging window with presigned S3 links for evidence. Do they need network diagrams + config snapshots too?
Sarah (sales): They explicitly listed SOC2 cert, control descriptions, network diagram, and pen-test letter. Also asked about whether dedicated capacity is required for their data residency check.
Marta (Security): For SOC2 artifacts we can share our attestation report and control matrix (redacted). Pen-test letter — we can provide a signed letter from our third-party vendor confirming engagement + high-level findings summary. We do NOT include raw vuln reports. Must redact any customer-identifying data.
Kevin (Pricing): Short answer on billing: if they require Dedicated/Dedicated-POC (single-tenant GPUs) for isolation there's a one-time reservation fee + prorated daily capacity rate. If they accept shared-hosted with VPC peering and ephemeral staging creds, there's no dedicated uplift — only standard usage. Estimated uplift: ~$8k/day for small Dedicated pool (2xA100).
Alejandro (SE): If they want the low-latency single-tenant experience I can spin a Dedicated pool, but it needs 48h lead to provision in the region. deploy-bot: scheduled capacity reservation request queued (#req-9842).
Sarah (sales): SummitHealth is pushing for Mon start though — do we have a faster path?
Marta (Security): We can do shared-hosted + stricter networking (customer IP allowlist, short-lived staging credentials) to meet residency checks for the POC. That avoids dedicated reserve. Share link to upload: https://redwood-inference.docs/evidence-upload (presigned flows).
Sam (Legal): For the pen-test attestation we need customer's legal signatory name to include on the letter. Also confirm they accept our standard redaction template.
Sarah (sales): I'll ask them for signatory and confirm redaction acceptance. Alejandro — can you prepare a checklist we can send today?
Alejandro (SE): Sending checklist now — include: SOC2 cert (pdf), control matrix (redacted xlsx), network diagram (png), pen-test letter (signed pdf), staging credentials timeline, contact for upload. Example snippet for S3 upload flow:
```
1) Request pre-signed link via evidence portal
2) Upload artifacts to presigned S3 path
3) We validate and notify within 24h
```
Kevin (Pricing): If they later convert POC to Dedicated reserved for production, we can offer a POC credit equal to 25% of the first month reservation if they sign within 30 days. Mention that in the checklist.
Marta (Security): Note: we cannot provide raw penetration test reports. Only the vendor attestation letter + summary of remediation status if applicable. Also, do not upload any PHI/PII in raw logs — redact before upload.
Sarah (sales): Perfect. I'll message the customer with checklist + ask for signatory + whether they accept shared-hosted with allowlist.
Sam (Legal): If they request a named pen-test letter addendum, route to legal for review — may take 48-72h.
deploy-bot: capacity request #req-9842 moved to provisioning queue (ETA 44h).
Sarah (sales): Thanks all. If SummitHealth insists on dedicated and we can't meet Mon start we'll propose shared-hosted for POC and dedicated for pilot. I'll update thread after I hear back. :thumbsup:
